hist-rus-01-c2.text: Encyclopedia of Ukraine (Canadian Institute of Ukrainian Studies, University of Alberta). Tatars. Encyclopedia of Ukraine.
hist-rus-01-c2.quote: After taking Kyiv he massacred its residents on 6 December 1240 and laid waste the city.
hist-rus-01-c2.claim: In December 1240 Kyiv fell to the Mongols.

hist-rus-01-c3.text: The Columbia Encyclopedia, 6th ed. Kulikovo, battle of. The Columbia Encyclopedia (via Encyclopedia.com).
hist-rus-01-c3.quote: Although the victory was the first Russian defeat of the Tatars, it did not eliminate Mongol rule, which endured for another century.
hist-rus-01-c3.claim: In 1380 Grand Prince Dmitry Donskoy defeated a Mongol force at the Battle of Kulikovo, a symbolic but premature first victory.
